detail: Exploratory, not preregistered; Olist adapter was test-context-informed before fitting.
BPI baseline has coarse modal history descriptors; no literal vendor names.
NoTransactions removes all transaction context in WWI, numerical/date/unit only in generic adapters.
UnitWeights uses frozen weighted estimator/policy; not a retrained ablation.
18 official WDC cells have train-test and/or validation-test offer overlap.
Candidate-cap output does not prove subquadratic computation.
Expanded verification is frozen replay, not fresh-environment retraining.
No human study; WDC ERP queries/context are not applicable.

visual_review.method: All 48 final pages inspected in Poppler-rendered contact sheets; dense query/WDC tables, figure legends, equations and bibliography reviewed. No clipping, overlap, missing tables or unreadable labels observed after corrections.
corrections: Supplement query column accessed explicitly and nonfinite values rejected
IEEE architecture enlarged to full width
Detailed bibliography consolidated and appendix heading/table kept together
